Celebrating America Through Song: Behind EPCOT's Voices of Liberty
For generations of EPCOT guests visiting the Walt Disney World Resort, the Voices of Liberty have been more than a performance, they've been an American tradition. 🎶 🇺🇸

To celebrate America's 250th, for the first time ever, go behind the scenes with the acclaimed a cappella ensemble as cast members and former singers share the history, legacy, and personal stories that have shaped one of EPCOT's most beloved entertainment offerings.

Step inside rehearsals, hear never-before-shared memories, and discover the dedication that goes into preserving the rich sound and spirit of Voices of Liberty. Through heartfelt interviews and rare backstage access, performers reflect on the friendships, milestones, and unforgettable moments that have defined their journeys over decades of singing beneath the rotunda of The American Adventure.

Whether you've stopped to listen for a few minutes or have made Voices of Liberty a must-do part of every EPCOT visit, this special look celebrates the people, passion, and harmony that continue to inspire guests from around the world.
